summary: Caldwell County fire tower built 1927 on private summit land; no longer in service but standing; the road to the top was closed to the public by court order.

facts.design: Fire tower with a 100-step stairway (site history page; Wikipedia)
facts.agency: Private owner Hibriten Mountain LLC; the NC Forest Service leased the summit for a fire tower (News-Topic)

staffing.as_of: undated (site says no longer in service)

access.note: Road to the top effectively closed to the public after an April 17 order by the Caldwell County Superior Court (year not in the text read). Wikipedia: privately owned, authorized individuals only. Tower base is fenced with barbed wire (site history page). News-Topic: for now, visitors may only climb with Hibriten Mountain LLC's express permission.

visit.trail_note: The road to the top is closed to the public and the tower base is fenced. Do not go past either.

events.note: Built 1927 per the Register's 'Built' field, the site history page and Wikipedia ('erected at the summit in 1927'). No builder named in the sources read.
Forest Service built a gate in the early 1940s to limit vehicle traffic on the private road; 1940 is a placeholder for 'early 1940s'
Lenoir News-Topic article dated November 5, 1987 on Dorothy Dellinger, one of the last people to work in the tower. The article PDF had no readable text.

notes_for_editor: Year of the closure order is not in the text we could read; the News-Topic page is partly paywalled, and the article's date was not visible. Land purchase in the early 2020s is in the article, so the closure is recent, but the year is unverified. The 1927 date is consistent across the Register, the site history page and Wikipedia, but Wikipedia cites the site, so they are not independent. The Dellinger 1987 article PDF is an image scan with no text; not used. A local archives Facebook post shows a 1928 photo of the tower and says its erection date was not found; that post was not opened, so it is not cited. Gate date 'early 1940s' is approximate. No fire history found. Read budget reached: 6 distinct pages and 2 searches. Verification 2026-10-09: the partly paywalled News-Topic text confirms the Forest Service lease, its duty to maintain the private road, and the early-1940s gate. The story now says 'effectively closed' and quotes the site's radio and cell tower line in full.
